outcomes.name: Understanding of the approach to managing resistance has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The approach to managing resistance is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that People Experience & Culture is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the approach to managing resistance.
Identify why the approach to managing resistance hasn't landed consistently for People Experience & Culture in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the approach to managing resistance for People Experience & Culture.
Confirm the approach to managing resistance for People Experience & Culture is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor People Experience & Culture regularly to ensure the approach to managing resistance stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Skills & Behaviour has been affected by inconsistent approach to managing resistance since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Skills & Behaviour-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Skills & Behaviour in teams/sites where the approach to managing resistance is weakest.
Confirm Skills & Behaviour has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Skills & Behaviour so gaps in the approach to managing resistance are caught early in future.
